title: Practice 5: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: I have breakfast at 7:30.
exercises.why: **завтракать → Завтракаю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Что с тобой такое? Ты всё время ___ (дёргаться) и ёрзаешь.
exercises.prompt: What's wrong with you? You keep twitching and fidgeting.
exercises.why: **дёргаться → дёргаешься** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Travel time is not taken into account.
exercises.why: **учитываться → учитывается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom sells T-shirts at a 30 percent discount.
exercises.why: **продавать → продаёт** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Tom is filling out the forms now.
exercises.why: **заполнять → заполняет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Решение дифференциального уравнения ___ (означать) нахождение функции, удовлетворяющей ему.
exercises.prompt: Resolving a differential equation means finding the functions that satisfy it.
exercises.why: **означать → означает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The sign '&' stands for 'and'.
exercises.why: **ставиться → ставится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: Его теории об эволюции почти на десятилетие ___ (опережать) дарвиновские.
exercises.prompt: His theories on evolution antedate Darwin's by nearly a decade.
exercises.why: **опережать → опережают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The file is still downloading.
exercises.why: **грузиться → грузится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.q: В России ___ (писать) «Таллин», а в Эстонии по-русски пишут «Таллинн».
exercises.prompt: In Russia they write "Tallin", and in Estonia they write "Tallinn" in Russian.
exercises.why: **писать → пишут** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: They're looking for the emergency exit.
exercises.why: **искать → ищут** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ут belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The Golden Ratio is found everywhere in nature.
exercises.why: **встречаться → встречается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Snooping as usual, I see.
exercises.why: **вынюхивать → вынюхиваете** — present tense, 2nd person plural: ending -ете belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: К сожалению, многие россияне ___ (иметь) неадекватные представления о происходящем в Киеве.
exercises.prompt: Unfortunately, many Russian citizens have an inadequate conception of what is happening in Kyiv.
exercises.why: **иметь → имеют** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: You are judged by appearances at first but by your mind later on.
exercises.why: **встречать → Встречают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: The Anonymous is still able to deliver.
exercises.why: **доставлять → доставляет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He's resting on his laurels.
exercises.why: **покоиться → покоится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: "Which element is represented by the symbol "H"?" "Hydrogen."
exercises.why: **обозначаться → обозначается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I refuse to leave.
exercises.why: **отказываться → отказываюсь** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.q: Ты думаешь, всё, что с нами ___ (происходить), предопределено?
exercises.prompt: Do you think that everything that happens to us is predestined?
exercises.why: **происходить → происходит** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
